summary: Stage 1 of the 10k single-node campaign is accepted on CPU format/seed grounds. notes/mfx_expand10_10k_20261106/fixture.py and verify.py are faithful forks of the reviewed Stage 2 tools: the only writer changes are the 1..10000 bound, directory mode 0o770, the 'project scratch' identity wording and progress prints; the only verifier changes are the bound, a cached per-stream schema dict, keyed (timestamp, panel) seed witnesses with duplicate rejection, progress prints and scope wording. All per-pixel seed/stride/CPU-expansion, scalar, non-JF payload, Names/schema, SMD-reference, transition-state and stream-alignment checks are unchanged from Stage 2. The shared xtc_fixture.py and runtime.sh hashes match the Stage 2 provenance record, so historical bindings are preserved. Size arithmetic closes exactly: the 20 per-file sizes agree across preflight.json, generation.json and files.json and sum to 37,682,986,080 bytes; seed_bytes equals 10000*32*52429*2. The schedule closes the truncated run with source-template Disable/EndStep/EndRun at +1000/+2000/+3000 ns after the last original event, and the verification timeline tail matches. campaign.py sets accepted only after verify() completes and reports are saved, uses atomic status checkpoints, refuses existing root/evidence directories, and re-runs preflight (including calibration shape/size/SHA256 checks and manifest hash) at run time. The copied verification report contains 320,000 seed_sha256 entries and 100,000 per-stream samples; summary.json shows 10,000 events per stream and per panel, one native step, PS_FAKESTEP_FLAG=0 and PS_PARALLEL=none. Job 43538554 is COMPLETED exit 0 with 10 unit tests passed and status phase complete/accepted true. GPU correctness remains established only on the 1k fixture; this stage makes no GPU or performance claim. Three low, optional hardening findings are recorded; none block acceptance.

findings.evidence: The status header (lines 3-6) still says 'Large-fixture preparation is deferred' and 'Only private scratch pilots have been generated', while lines 37-45 of the same document and notes/mfx_expand10_10k_20261106/README.md record a 37,682,986,080-byte fixture written to prjdatpsana project scratch in job 43538554.
findings.requested_change: Optional documentation-only closure: update the header status to state that the 10k project-scratch fixture exists and is CPU-validated (review state as applicable), or qualify 'private scratch pilots' so the header no longer contradicts the Single-node follow-up paragraph.

findings.evidence: The failure path catches BaseException and writes phase 'failed', but no SIGTERM handler is installed; a Slurm preemption or time-limit kill would leave status.json at 'generating' or 'verifying' rather than 'failed'. Acceptance semantics are unaffected because accepted stays false until line 119.
findings.requested_change: Optional hardening outside this fixed scope: install a SIGTERM handler that raises so the 'failed' checkpoint is written, or document that a lingering 'generating'/'verifying' phase denotes an interrupted job.

findings.evidence: root.mkdir uses mode 0o770 but (root/'smalldata').mkdir() and the 'xb' file opens rely on the process umask; group accessibility is guaranteed only because campaign.py sets os.umask(0o007) before calling make(). The standalone __main__ path (lines 217-223) does not set the umask.
findings.requested_change: Optional hardening: set the umask or explicit modes inside make() so standalone invocation yields the same group-accessible layout. No change required for the accepted job, whose access.txt confirms the intended ACLs.
